comment: The prebuilt data pack (owner 2026-11-16): normal builds do not rebuild the word base from the corpora; they put these files into src/Data.Build/out/ and check them with « python -I src/Data.Build/verify_data_pack.py ». Rebuilding them (data.lock.json, corpus/, build_*.py) is the maintainers' path. The « Noms propres » pack has its own edition and lock (pepite-noms/names.lock.json); the pictures and voices have their own fetch scripts.

pack.url_note: the asset pepite-data-2026.11.1.zip of the data release data-2026.11.2 (plan 13; the same bytes as in data-2026.11): fetched, checked and unpacked by fetch_data_release.py (data-release.lock.json), then checked file by file here
pack.built_from: src/Data.Build/data.lock.json (corpus inputs), grammar.lock.json (French.lex); plan corpus-light Phase 2; spelling.sqlite: build_spelling_ref.py (same French.lex pin)
pack.change_note: 2026.11.1 (publication cleanup, 2026-11-16): the spelling tables moved out of prediction.sqlite (CC BY-SA 4.0) into spelling.sqlite (MPL-2.0, derived from French.lex) with its notices; prediction.sqlite otherwise unchanged (same words and n-gram rows, VACUUMed); prediction-SOURCES.txt header updated.
